tracks.title: Sabun Kecil dari Tiap Kota
tracks.mood: hangat, sabar, rindu yang tenang (warm, patient, quietly missing him)
tracks.subject: In their first rented house in Sidoarjo, a wife lines the bathroom shelf with the hotel soaps her husband, a travelling generator technician, brings home from every town, reads his month from the wrappers, and never unwraps the one from their honeymoon in Batu.
